descriptionWindows: Strip down Windows — remove telemetry, bloatware, and unnecessary services
descriptionOther: Harden your system — manage privacy settings and unnecessary services

privacy.pageDescription: Control telemetry, ads, tracking, and data collection across your system
privacy.emptyStateDescription: Click \"Scan\" to audit your privacy and security settings and apply recommended hardening.
privacy.adminWarning: Some settings require administrator privileges to modify. Run Atlas as administrator for full protection.
privacy.safetyWarningDescription: On a business computer, consult IT before applying or reverting protections in this tab. Scanning is read-only; changes may affect Windows features or your organization's settings.
privacy.ipcCallFailed: IPC call failed — try running as administrator
privacy.settingNotApplied: The system did not report the change — it may need a restart, or the setting may be managed by another profile

privacyCategories.telemetryDescription: Control diagnostic and usage data collection
privacyCategories.adsDescription: Block promoted apps, ad suggestions, and lock screen spotlight
privacyCategories.searchDescription: Keep searches local and disable web-based search features
privacyCategories.syncDescription: Control clipboard syncing, settings sync, and device tracking
privacyCategories.servicesDescription: Disable background services that collect and upload telemetry
privacyCategories.tasksDescription: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks running in the background
privacyCategories.kernelDescription: Kernel security parameters and memory protection via sysctl
privacyCategories.networkDescription: Network stack hardening and traffic filtering via sysctl
privacyCategories.accessDescription: Access control policies, SSH hardening, and system restrictions
privacyCategories.aiDescription: Disable Copilot, Recall, and other AI features that analyze your data
privacyCategories.browserDescription: Stop browsers from reporting usage data to Microsoft, Google, and Mozilla

tweaks.safetyWarningDescription: The adjustments in this tab change Windows settings and may affect features, apps, or organization policies. If this computer belongs to a company or is managed by IT, consult the responsible team before applying or reverting any adjustment.
tweaks.pageDescription: Personalize Windows and tune power, network, and system behavior
tweaks.emptyStateDescription: Click \"Scan\" to check which personalization, power, and network tweaks are already applied.
tweaks.windowsOnlyWarning: System Tweaks currently only supports Windows.
tweaks.adminWarning: Some tweaks require administrator privileges to modify. Run Atlas as administrator to apply all of them.
tweaks.ipcCallFailed: IPC call failed — try running as administrator
tweaks.settingNotApplied: The system did not report the change — it may need a restart, or the setting may be managed by another profile

dark-mode.label: Dark Mode
dark-mode.description: Switch apps and the Windows interface to the dark theme.

taskbar-left-align.label: Left-align Taskbar
taskbar-left-align.description: Move taskbar icons to the left, like in Windows 10.

taskbar-search-icon-only.label: Compact Taskbar Search
taskbar-search-icon-only.description: Replace the search box with a smaller icon.

show-hidden-files.label: Show Hidden Files
show-hidden-files.description: Show hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

show-file-extensions.label: Show File Extensions
show-file-extensions.description: Show extensions such as .txt and .jpg for known file types.

classic-context-menu.label: Classic Context Menu
classic-context-menu.description: Restore the full Windows 10 right-click menu in Windows 11.

disable-mouse-acceleration.label: Disable Mouse Acceleration
disable-mouse-acceleration.description: Turn off “Enhance pointer precision” for more consistent mouse movement.

always-show-scrollbars.label: Always Show Scrollbars
always-show-scrollbars.description: Keep scrollbars visible instead of hiding them automatically.

numlock-on-startup.label: Enable NumLock at Startup
numlock-on-startup.description: Turn NumLock on whenever Windows starts, including at sign-in.

disable-sticky-keys-hotkey.label: Disable Sticky Keys Prompt
disable-sticky-keys-hotkey.description: Stop the prompt from appearing when Shift is pressed five times.

verbose-logon-messages.label: Detailed Windows Sign-in Messages
verbose-logon-messages.description: Show detailed status messages during startup, sign-in, and shutdown.

enable-long-paths.label: Enable Long Paths
enable-long-paths.description: Allow file paths longer than 260 characters.

ultimate-performance-plan.label: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
ultimate-performance-plan.description: Activate Windows’ hidden Ultimate Performance power plan.

disable-hibernation.label: Disable Hibernation
disable-hibernation.description: Disable hibernation and remove hiberfil.sys to free disk space.

disable-ipv6.label: Disable IPv6
disable-ipv6.description: Disable IPv6 on all network adapters. A restart is required.

disable-teredo.label: Disable Teredo
disable-teredo.description: Disable the Teredo IPv6 tunneling interface.

remove-onedrive.label: Uninstall OneDrive
remove-onedrive.description: Uninstall Microsoft OneDrive and remove it from File Explorer. Atlas cannot undo this; you will need to reinstall it manually.

tweaksCategories.personalizationDescription: Theme, taskbar, File Explorer, and accessibility.
tweaksCategories.systemDescription: Bundled Windows apps and system settings.

debloater.pageDescription: Remove pre-installed Windows apps and OEM bloatware
debloater.irreversibleWarning: Removal may require reinstalling from the Microsoft Store or the manufacturer's website. Review each app's warning before continuing.
debloater.removalRiskOptionalDescription: If you do not use the app, removal is likely to affect only its features.
debloater.removalRiskReviewDescription: Removal may affect specific features, such as Xbox games, security, manufacturer support, or work tools.
debloater.removalRiskEssentialNote: Essential Windows components are not listed here. Some apps may still be important for features you use.
debloater.emptyStateDescription: Click \"Scan\" to find pre-installed apps and OEM bloatware.
debloater.confirmDescription: This will remove {{count}} app(s). You may need to reinstall them from the Microsoft Store or the manufacturer's website.
debloater.confirmReviewWarning: {{count}} selected item(s) are marked for review. Check which apps they are before continuing.
debloater.scanFailedError: Failed to scan for bloatware. Make sure PowerShell is available.
debloater.removeFailedError: Failed to remove some apps. Administrator privileges may be required.

serviceManager.pageDescription: Understand what each service does, select what you want to change, and review it before applying.
serviceManager.safetyWarningDescription: If this computer is managed by an organization, consult your IT team before changing services or applying recommendations. Changes may affect security policies, networking, remote support, and other business features.
serviceManager.infoBannerUseRecommended: Use \"Apply Recommended\" for a safe one-click preset.
serviceManager.infoBannerReEnable: Select a disabled service to turn it back on.
serviceManager.howItWorks: How it works: scanning makes no changes. Select services in the list; “Select recommended” replaces the current selection and marks only lower-risk items. Then choose Disable or Enable and review the names before confirming.
serviceManager.emptyStateDescription: Enumerate all services and identify which ones can be safely disabled to improve performance.
serviceManager.safeGroupHelp: Atlas classification. Even lower-risk services may affect features depending on how this computer is used and configured.
serviceManager.cautionGroupHelp: These services may be needed for specific features. Check the description before changing them.
serviceManager.unsafeGroupHelp: Atlas blocks disabling these services. If one is already disabled, you can select it to re-enable it.
serviceManager.confirmDescription: Atlas will disable {{count}} service(s) and stop any that are running. Review the listed names before confirming. Administrator privileges are required.
serviceManager.confirmEnableDescription: Atlas will re-enable {{count}} service(s) with {{startType}} startup. Automatic services start immediately. Review the listed names before confirming. Administrator privileges are required.
